entries.title: Psalms 81:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. On Gittith, A Psalm of Asaph. Sing aloud to God our strength; shout for joy to the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 81:2
segments: Lift up a psalm, and bring the timbrel here, the pleasing lyre and harp.

entries.title: Psalms 81:3
segments: Blow the ram's horn in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

entries.title: Psalms 81:4
segments: For this [was] a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 81:5
segments: This He ordained in Joseph [for] a testimony, when He went out over the land of Egypt; I heard a language I understood not.

entries.title: Psalms 81:6
segments: I removed his shoulder from the burden; his hands were delivered from the pots.

entries.title: Psalms 81:7
segments: You called in trouble, and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 81:8
segments: Hear, O My people, and I will testify to you; O Israel, if you will listen to Me,

entries.title: Psalms 81:9
segments: there shall be no strange god in you; nor shall you worship any strange god.

entries.title: Psalms 81:10
segments: I [am] the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt; open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

entries.title: Psalms 81:11
segments: But My people would not listen to My voice, and Israel would have none of Me.

entries.title: Psalms 81:12
segments: So I gave them up to the stubbornness of their own hearts; [and] they walked in their own conceits.

entries.title: Psalms 81:13
segments: Oh that My people had listened to Me, [and] Israel had walked in My ways!

entries.title: Psalms 81:14
segments: I would soon have humbled their enemies, and would have turned My hand against their foes.

entries.title: Psalms 81:15
segments: The haters of the LORD would have been found liars to Him, and their time would have lasted forever.

entries.title: Psalms 81:16
segments: And He would have fed them also with the finest of the wheat; and [with] honey out of the rock I would have satisfied you.
